message:
You know, when I hear the weather forecast predicting storms, I can't help but think back to the time I hunkered down with my grandkids and we made a game out of preparing for a potential tornado. We gathered our supplies, practiced our safety plan, and even turned it into a mini scavenger hunt. 

It felt like a small win that saved the day: we were ready! Plus, it gave the kids a sense of control over something that can feel a bit scary. 

I found a great resource that outlines some helpful tips for storm preparedness. It’s worth a glance if you’re looking to add a little peace of mind to your own routine. How about you? Any tips for making preparedness a bit more fun or engaging? 🌪️
